testcase.name: sixteen bytes a point, so the size is the point count times sixteen
one point round-trips and takes sixteen bytes, two doubles
bytes that are not a whole number of points are refused, never read as a shorter path
a path round-trips exactly, in order, every coordinate identical
an empty path round-trips as an empty path and encodes to no bytes
negative zero survives, so the round trip is bit for bit and not merely numerically equal
